title: OpenSCAD workflows and connector status
description: Explore OpenSCAD workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

OpenSCAD project

OpenSCAD

OpenSCAD creates solid models from declarative scripts and reproducible parameters.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Define a scripted part

Begin with current feature dimensions, datums and design intent. In the intended OpenSCAD preview, define a scripted part; the visible result is the revised solid and its driving constraints. Review interfaces, retained references and manufacturable intent before accepting or exporting it.

Generate a parameter variant

Use the selected part or assembly revision. In the intended OpenSCAD preview, generate a parameter variant; the visible result is an updated assembly state with affected relationships highlighted. Review fit, motion, access and clearance before accepting or exporting it.

Export geometry for inspection

Start from the reviewed model and release properties. In the intended OpenSCAD preview, export geometry for inspection; the visible result is a drawing, bill of materials or model definition tied to that revision. Review dimensions, revision identity and downstream completeness before accepting or exporting it.
